mentions.name: withfire.app
mentions.description: AI-driven resume tailoring web app that ingests job postings via a bookmarklet (clicking it auto-parses the posting into your list), tailors resumes to each posting, asks users whether they have skills mentioned in postings that are missing from their profile so the profile improves over time, and produces human-looking resume output closely matching hand-made resumes. The author reports it increased his job-application hear-back rate by about 5x.
mentions.source_excerpt: The first is withfire.app, which is basically a productization of the AI driven resume tailoring pipeline I used during my last job search.
